=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1946 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The merge-mode lease-wait caller prints "Waiting under ${MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL:-ai:merge-lease-wait}." for every lease wait, including the holder-overlap wait (reason=holder_shares_paths), which adds no label.
  WHY: The PR is a live holder that `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi` keeps in tm_excluded, so the tick never grants or re-dispatches it, and the real retry comes from the review sweep (review_autofix_sweep.yml:749 skips only labelled PRs); operators see a false label state, though merge behaviour is correct (all reviewers rated NIT).
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3318-3331 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The merge-mode holder-overlap branch of `_merge_lease_gate_multi` returns 1 (wait) but skips `_merge_lease_gate_multi_wait` and adds no `ai:merge-lease-wait` label, which breaks the documented contract that a waiting PR is labelled.
  WHY: Callers, logs and documentation describe a label and wait-and-dispatch process that does not apply to this branch, so the reported state and retry path are wrong (all reviewers rated NIT; google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite flagged it under both CORRECTNESS and NAMING / BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY).
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3515-3517 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `_merge_lease_gate` header still says "A waiting PR is labelled MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL" and does not carry the holder exception that the `_merge_lease_gate_multi` header now states (line 3275: "1 wait (labelled, except a holder's merge-mode wait)").
  WHY: Future readers and contract tests that work from this header will assume every wait adds the label, so the header and the runtime disagree (all reviewers rated NIT).
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:330-332 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The PR_BASE_FRESHNESS_OUTCOME=lease_wait branch prints "The merge-train release re-dispatches this PR when the lease is granted to it," which is false for a holder waiting on an earlier holder in merge mode.
  WHY: The merge-train release pass excludes live holders and never grants them the lease, so only the review sweep retries this PR, and operators wait for the wrong path (NIT; minimax_minimax-m3 confidence 4, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash confidence 5).
- agents.d/merge-lease-parallel-p5-multi-holder.md:6 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The merge-mode bullet reads "Merge mode waits on the first holder sharing a path (`_merge_lease_paths_intersect` with both heads)" and does not mention the unlabelled holder exception or the review-sweep retry path.
  WHY: The fragment is the contract record of merge-lease Phase 5, so tests, ledger parsers and downstream agents that key off it will miss the new behaviour (NIT).
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3432 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The update-mode renewal fallback in `_merge_lease_gate_multi` checks for multiple holders with `gm_count`, which counts only live holders; with one live and one expired row and no `holder_path=` line for this PR, it records the union of paths instead of `*`.
  WHY: An expired holder's paths can be attributed to the renewing PR, which causes false overlaps and needless waits (NIT; same root cause as the next entry, but the cited lines are too far apart to merge under the dedup rules).
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3391-3395 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The renewal fallback records `*` only when `gm_count > 1`, so a record with one live row, one or more expired rows and no `holder_path=` line for the renewing PR falls through to `_merge_lease_holder_paths`, which returns the union `MERGE_LEASE_PATHS`.
  WHY: The renewal widens the PR's recorded paths to include paths no live holder changed, so later merge-mode overlap checks can see false overlaps; this is rare because `_merge_lease_write_holders` does not produce such records, but it is reachable (NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1946 (also header 3516-3517; scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:330-331) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The merge-mode holder branch of `_merge_lease_gate_multi` (around lines 3318-3331) still returns 1 (reason=holder_shares_paths) but skips `_merge_lease_gate_multi_wait` and adds no wait label. The callers still log "Waiting under ai:merge-lease-wait" and "The merge-train release re-dispatches this PR when the lease is granted to it."
  WHY: The PR is a live holder that `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi` keeps in tm_excluded, so the tick never grants or re-dispatches it. The actual retry is the review sweep (review_autofix_sweep.yml:749 skips only labelled PRs). Merge behaviour is correct, but the logs and the header contract are wrong. Suggested fix (~3 lines): print a different message when MERGE_LEASE_REASON=holder_shares_paths and lease_pr is a holder, and amend the header at line 3517.
- HARDENING: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_merge_lease_gate_multi` update-mode renewal fallback | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=1
  ISSUE: The guard `gm_count -gt 1` counts only live holders. With one live row, one expired row and no holder_path= line, the fallback uses the union `paths:`, which includes the expired holder's paths. The result is stricter, not weaker, and is reachable only from records that `_merge_lease_write_holders` did not write.
  FIX: Guard on `[ -n "${MERGE_LEASE_HOLDER_PATHS:-}" ] && ! printf ... | grep -q ...`. Estimated 1 line.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

  PROBLEM: The renewal fallback checks for multiple holders with `gm_count`, which counts only live holders. With one live and one expired holder (`gm_count` is 1) and no `holder_path=` line for this PR, it may record the union of paths instead of `*`.
  WHY: An expired holder's paths could be attributed to the renewing PR, which causes false overlaps and unnecessary waits.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3318-3331 (in _merge_lease_gate_multi merge-mode holder overlap) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The branch returns 1 to signal a wait but does not apply `ai:merge-lease-wait`. `_merge_lease_gate` and `agents.d/merge-lease-parallel-p5-multi-holder.md` still say waiting PRs are labelled.
  WHY: The logs and documentation misrepresent the state. The PR has no label, so the review sweep does not skip it, which is inconsistent with the documented wait-and-dispatch process.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3318-3331 (NAMING / BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The branch returns 1 without the wait label, which contradicts the established contract that a waiting PR is labelled `ai:merge-lease-wait`.
  WHY: Callers and operators who rely on the label for re-dispatch or status tracking see inconsistent behaviour, and the log, which says a label was applied, is misleading.
